title: Public phone-access status
responsibility: Build displayable computer status from persisted state and live relay and pairing activity.

inputs.name: remoteHostStatus.input
inputs.description: Support flag, persisted state, runtime, phase, reason, display name and available project IDs/names.

outputs.name: remoteHostStatus
outputs.description: Public status with enabled state, connection phase, host, pairing offer and requests, approved device summaries and projects; private keys and credentials are omitted.
